text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with dark hair in a high updo, fine loose bangs and cheek-framing wisps, warm brown eyes, pale peach skin, a delicate tapered face and rust rose lips. A tiny beauty mark near one eye. Ornate gold hairpins and long gold earrings, rust and antique gold brocade robes, layered decorative trim. Complete floor-length rust-red and antique gold brocade wrap gown with gray-gold crossing collar, wide sleeves, narrow layered waist sash, continuous flowing full SKIRT and restrained panels, rust-gold embroidered flat shoe tips visible. No pants. Tall poised 176 cm. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
